# omkarharyan.paperkitelabs.com

> Personal site of Omkar Haryan (data science student, Mumbai) and home of "SSC Board Papers · Maharashtra", a free library of Maharashtra SSC (Class 10) previous year board question papers.

## SSC Board Papers · Maharashtra

Free PDFs of real Maharashtra State Board (MSBSHSE) SSC / Class 10 board question papers, checked against the paper code and exam date printed on each paper. No login.

- Board papers: March 2019–2026, plus supplementary exams (June-July, August, September). The March 2021 exam was cancelled due to COVID; the September 2021 papers for Algebra, Geometry, Science 1 and Science 2 are included.
- Subjects: Algebra (Maths 1), Geometry (Maths 2), Science 1, Science 2, History and Political Science, Geography, Marathi, Hindi, English, Sanskrit, Urdu, Arabic, German.
- Mediums: English and Marathi medium for all main subjects (2022–2026), plus Hindi, Urdu and Kannada medium where the board printed them. Language papers are the same for every medium.
- Also: school prelim papers (2024-25, 2025-26), SCERT Maharashtra question banks (2022, 2023), model papers.
- Paper pattern: language papers 80 marks, 3 hours (composite papers 40 marks, 2 hours); Maths 1 and 2, Science 1 and 2, History and Geography 40 marks, 2 hours each.
